c.h: This guide describes the most effective methods to train the Runecrafting skill. The experience rate estimates in this guide do not incorporate the use of any experience boosting items or bonus experience. Runecrafting is an artisan skill which involves using runecrafting altars to create runes from rune essence, pure essence and impure essence. Levelling up the Runecrafting skill allows players to create runes which award greater amounts of experience when they are crafted. Having a higher Runecrafting level also increases the player's chance of creating multiple runes from a single piece of essence, though this does not grant additional Runecrafting experience.

This is a dangerous activity that takes place in the Wilderness or another PvP area.
If you die, you will lose your items and will not be able to reclaim them from Death or your gravestone if you have opted into PvP.

Players can train Runecrafting by using the Abyss to travel to runecrafting altars to create runes.

Entering the Abyss drains the player's prayer points.

1. Teleport to Edgeville using a Wilderness sword 1
  2. Fill your runecrafting pouches or have them prefilled with presets and inventory with Pure essence.
  3. Run north towards the Wilderness wall (the Surge ability can be used to cut down running time).
  4. Enter the Wilderness and walk north to the Mage of Zamorak (see map on the right)
  5. Right-click the Mage of Zamorak and Teleport.
  6. Use the nearest shortcut to move into the inner ring of the Abyss. ("squeeze through gap", "mine rocks", "distract eyes", etc)
  7. Run to the rift of your desired rune (check the map for the optimal rune to craft).
  8. Use altar to craft runes.
  9. Repeat from step 1.

• Players are required to complete the Enter the Abyss miniquest before they can use the Abyss, which will level them to level 9 Runecrafting.
  • Players additionally need to complete quests to gain access to higher tier runecrafting altars:
    • To create cosmic runes at 27 Runecrafting, the quest Lost City is required
    • To create death runes at 65 Runecrafting, the quest Mourning's End Part II is required
    • To create blood runes at 77 Runecrafting, the quest Legacy of Seergaze is required
    • To create soul runes at 90 Runecrafting, the quest 'Phite Club is required
    • To create time runes at 100 Runecrafting, anchoring the time ruins by the enchanted key from Making History or the enchanted key from Meeting History is required

• Bank preset:
    • It is recommended that players create a bank preset with the items shown on the right.
    • Presets can now take advantage of pre-filled pouches.
    • The preset should have the hotkey 3 assigned (see the action bar below)
  • Secondary action bar:
    • It is recommended that players create a secondary action bar with the teleports (simply drag these items on it)
    • This allows players to assign hotkeys to these abilities, speeding up their usage greatly
    • An example of a secondary action bar, along with hotkey assignments:

    • The Wilderness sword is the fastest free teleport to get to Edgeville, close to the edge of the wilderness.
    • It is awarded for completion of the easy set of Wilderness Tasks, which has no skill or quest requirements to obtain.
    • Furthermore, if the player has acquired the Wilderness Sword 3, which is a reward for completing the hard set of Wildnerness achievements, the Mage of Zamorak sometimes teleports the Player in the inner circle of the Abyss, 20% of the time. However, the sword has to be equipped or in the inventory for this effect to take place.
  • Explorer's ring 2 (or higher tier, optional)
    • If crafting elemental runes (air, earth, fire, or water), an equipped explorer's ring 2 (or higher tier) offers a 10% chance of crafting an additional rune per essence, granting additional experience.
  • Ring of imbuing (optional)
    • Alternatively, an equipped Ring of Imbuing provides 10% extra runes

Runecrafting pouches can be used to store essence. Essence stored in pouches is automatically used to create runes upon clicking a runecrafting altar. Runecrafting pouches, with the exception of the small pouch, degrade after a certain number of uses. Once a pouch is degraded it will not be able to store as much essence.

If a player continues to use a degraded pouch then it will be destroyed. Pouch Protector is the best way to ensure your pouches don't degrade. Players can repair pouches for free by speaking to the Dark Mage, who is found at the centre of the Abyss. Other methods are using Repair Rune Pouch spell, runecrafter's catalyst fragment and the combined catalyst fragment.

c.t: Runecrafting at the soul altar — overview
c.h:
At level 90 Runecrafting players can train at the soul altar. It is a very AFK method and players gain large amounts of XP. The mechanics of using the soul altar differ from the standard process of Runecrafting using the Abyss. Before use, the altar must first be 'charged' with pure essence. Players can then craft the soul runes and gain 77,000 experience before boosts. 1 charge is created from each 4 pure essence used in the charger; the charger may hold up to 100 pure essence at once, and the altar may hold up to 100 charges at once.

Using all available boosts, up to 768 runes can be crafted per full trip.

For the fastest experience rates, the soul altar should always be accessed via the fairy ring , but if the player wishes to receive magical thread, they should use the following method:

1. Visit the soul altar multiple times at fairy ring and charge the altar using a total of 400 Pure essence
  2. Teleport to Edgeville using the Wilderness sword 1
  3. Teleport to the Abyss using the Mage of Zamorak
  4. Head to the inner ring of the Abyss and enter the Soul Altar
  5. Use powerburst of sorcery
  6. Craft soul runes at the soul altar

To use the soul altar, players require:

  • Completion of the 'Phite Club quest

You need any method to teleport repeatedly to fairy rings:

  • Portable fairy ring created at 94 Invention
  • Grace of the elves
  • Skill portals in the Max Guild tuned to the Zanaris fairy ring
  • Cape of legends to teleport to a nearby fairy ring
  • House Teleport to a fairy ring in the player-owned house

c.t: Runecrafting using a Runic attuner — overview
c.h:
The primary benefit of the runic attuner is the item's passive effect Runic Attunement, which grants a 2,200% experience bonus on every 50th attunement to an altar. The strategy is to go through the first 49 attunements as quickly as possible and finish the 50th attunement on a fully charged soul altar, as the altar's mechanics grant a large amount of experience in a single set of runes compared to other altars.

At level 105, using a fully charged soul altar as the 50th attunement will result in a minimum of 550,000 experience in addition to any experience gained from the first 49 trips. This requires a minimum time of 10 minutes to fully charge the Soul Altar, plus any time necessary to reach the 50th attunement. It is theoretically possible to achieve 2 attunement cycles every hour (20 minutes charging, leaving 40 minutes to do ~60 trips) with perfect movement, Surge, Dive, Escape, and Barge usage, leading to an XP rate well in excess of 1.5m XP/hour with an Abyssal titan and Infinity ethereal outfit. More realistic rates result in approximately 32 minutes per 50 attunements, leading to rates around 1m XP/hour.

Most altar runs will be going through the Abyss, so focus on making the abyss runs as efficient as possible.

  1. Starting from the Wilderness sword teleport, Dive into the Edgeville bank and reload last used preset.
  2. Go north out of the bank and run past the building north of the bank to get a max distance Surge to the wilderness ditch.
  3. Surge immediately after crossing the ditch. It can be spammed to have it input as soon as possible.
  4. Go around the tree to get a max distance Dive north towards the Mage of Zamorak. Optionally, stepping backwards for 1 tick and using Escape or using Barge on a skeleton can save around 1 second per trip.
  5. Nexus Mod will place you directly in front of the altar rift, turn the camera and click 2 tiles in front to enter the rift immediately. The direction to change the camera depends on which altar is the current attunement, so memorising which direction each altar is placed in the abyss can speed up runs slightly.
  6. Craft the runes and double press the wilderness sword keybind to teleport back to Edgeville to restart the run.

Optimally, an abyss run can range from 22 to 33 seconds depending on teleport drop off locations. A 1 charge soul altar attunement will use approximately 10 seconds.

• Expansive pouch is the best pouch to use. If not owned, use all other runecrafting pouches owned.
  • Infinity ethereal outfit holds extra essence and can inherit the experience bonus of the Master runecrafter robes.
  • Wilderness sword 4 is used to teleport to Edgeville and must be in the inventory or worn for the increased magical thread chance. The wilderness sword must be unaugmented to have the teleport option be its first option when using a keybind. While holding the crystal binding rod, press the wilderness sword keybind twice to equip and teleport to Edgeville quickly.
    • Additionally, it can be used to Barge a skeleton, as the Crystal binding rod is not classified as a melee weapon.
  • Crystal binding rod can be perked with Wild Runes or Polishing depending on personal preference. Getting one of these perk activations on certain altars may be worse than if it did not activate, so the wilderness sword can be equipped before crafting to prevent the perk activation.
  • Brooch of the Gods and Urn enhancer if runecrafting urns are being used. Omit these if not using urns. Brooch of the Gods can still be used, but if going very fast, the blessing can be missed and teleported away from.
  • Powerburst of sorcery stored in 1 dose in the bank. Use on any altar to maximize profit or based on personal preference. Does not provide extra experience, can be omitted if desired.
  • Ring of imbuing and Runecrafting cape only provide extra runes but not experience. However, there are no notable replacements for these items.
  • Necklace of Shadows prevents summoning point drain to resummon abyssal familiars. However, War's Retreat Teleport is very close to an altar and bank and does not lose much time to resummon a new familiar. Alternatively, Grace of the elves can be used for a 0 step bank to Deep Sea Fishing hub when using the Runic attuner's 10th attunement teleport.
  • Tirannwn quiver 3 and 4 provide 5 daily teleports to the death altar and can be used quickly after an abyss run at the bank while retaining the abyss runecrafting bonus.
  • Nexus Mod saves approximately 5 seconds per abyss run and should be used. Shadow's Grace must be used because the Crystal binding rod has no combination perks with Mobile and the Wilderness sword must be unaugmented. Pouch Protector can be used if not using the expansive pouch or use Inspire Genius for experience.
  • Elemental anima stones and catalytic anima stones should be withdrawn from the bank situationally, as they do not provide profit for every rune crafted.
  • Insatiable spirit necklace and corresponding anima stones can be used for minimal experience gain.

• As the majority of the experience gained in a full attunement cycle is from the Runic Attunement experience bonus, reducing the time taken to complete an attunement cycle will boost experience gained. Using Nexus Mod or alternate teleport methods can increase runs per hour and allow for more attunement cycles.
  • Before runecrafting at the soul altar for the 50th attunement, make sure that:
    • The altar is fully charged
    • Fresh re-entry through the abyss for magical thread
    • The crystal binding rod is unequipped so that Wild Runes or Polishing do not activate
    • 3-4 empty inventory slots so that runecrafting urns can populate the spaces and multiple get filled
    • Powerburst of sorcery is used and catalytic anima stones are in the inventory
  • If the attuner attunes to the soul altar before the 50th attunement, only charge and craft one rune worth of essence at the soul altar. A large amount of time is needed to fully charge the altar, and the benefit of reaching the 50th attunement outweighs the immediate experience loss.
  • Take advantage of the "free choice" attunements at multiples of 7 energy absorbed. A player can drop one essence right before the 7th, 14th, 21st, 28th, 35th, and 42nd set of runes crafted (attuner status shows 6, 13, 20, 27, 34, 41) and then immediately pick it up to craft it at the same altar. This method allows for two attunements in a single trip.
    • Do not use this for the 49th attunement to take advantage of the 50th attunement experience bonus. The 14th attunement may also be skipped to utilise the bonus +50% runes crafted for the 15th attunement if profit over experience is desired.
    • Nexus Mod will put you at the north of the abyss centre, and no Nexus Mod will put you at the south outside of the centre. For speed, enter the nature or astral altar if using Nexus Mod or the time altar without Nexus Mod, based on personal preference.
    • The runic attuner has a passive that makes higher level altars more likely to be rerolled, so players can optionally drop an essence and hope for a same altar attunement at a high level altar like blood or time.
  • Use alternate methods to get to altars without needing to run through the Abyss. Several teleportation methods can bring the player to a Runecrafting altar faster than using the Abyss to speed up the attuner cycle, sacrificing the acquisition of magical thread and experience. The player will still gain magical thread every 25 energy absorbed. A full Abyss run optimally takes 25-30 seconds, so the teleportation method must beat this time to be used over going to the Abyss every time. This should also include the time to pull these teleports out of the bank compared to loading the previous preset. The teleportation methods include:
    • After every 10th attunement, the runic attuner gains a charge to directly teleport to the attuned altar. The charge does not carry over if it is not used, so remember to use it after banking to save the time of a full abyss run. It will not teleport anywhere if the current attunement is to any altar.
    • Runecrafting teleport tablets teleports directly to a specific Runecrafting altar, with the exception of the soul altar and time altar.
    • Wicked hood teleport directly to altars but has a limited amount of charges. This speeds up the attunement cycle, but the Savvy runecrafting benefit is removed.
    • Skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village near the body altar.
    • Skills necklace to teleport to Cooks' Guild near the air altar.
    • Home Teleport to teleport to Fort Forinthry lodestone near the earth altar.
    • Ring of duelling to teleport to Het's Oasis near the fire altar.
    • Moonclan Teleport spell or tablet to teleport near the astral altar.
    • Tirannwn quiver 3 or 4 for five daily teleports to the death altar.
    • Fairy ring teleports to the Menaphos Imperial district near the soul altar.
    • North-western Anachronia Teleport spell or tablet to teleport near the time altar.

Players wishing for a less intensive training method may train at Runespan. Runespan is a dimension composed of islands that are inhabited by nodes, creatures and floating essence. Runespan is split over 3 levels; the upper level, middle level and lower level. While at Runespan, players can siphon from creatures and nodes to receive runes and Runecrafting experience, until the creature or node is broken down. Creatures will always respawn on the same island that they were broken down on, while nodes spawn more randomly. Rune essence is required in order to siphon from creatures and nodes. Players can gain 50 essence upon successfully breaking down a creature and up to 25 essence from floating essence, if they currently have less than 25 essence. The runes and rune essence used within Runespan are untradeable and cannot be taken out of the area. Runes can be used to use platforms to move between the dimension's islands. Upon leaving Runespan runes are converted into Runespan points, which can be used to purchase rewards. While in Runespan players can exchange Runespan points with Wizard Finix to receive 10 of each type of rune that they are able to create.

To effectively train within Runespan, players should prioritise siphoning from nodes that give the best experience rates, using platforms to travel to islands where these nodes are present and obtaining more rune essence from floating essence when necessary. These nodes tend to spawn more frequently on the upper levels of Runespan, so players should train at the highest level that they are able to access. Use the tables below, which show a theoretical experience per hour that could be achieved if a player with 99 Runecrafting were able to constantly siphon from a particular type of node, to identify the nodes which give the best experience rates.

With levels 1-9 Runecrafting players can gain experience rates equivalent to around 16,500 experience an hour siphoning from nodes on island 1 (see map). Players can gain between 26,000 experience an hour, with level 9 Runecrafting, and 28,500 experience an hour with level 33 Runecrafting siphoning from nodes on island 16.

Unlocked at 100 Runecrafting, imbuing eternal magic weapons is a more AFK Runecrafting method than the Runespan, and can yield a profit if selling the final product instead of sacrificing it. By taking eternal magic wands, orbs, or staves and imbuing them with rune essence at Runecrafting altars, one can create tier 85 or 90 weapons or sacrifice them for more xp. This is similar to Smithing's burial smithing and Fletching's martial fletching.

At level 106 Runecrafting, up to 287,600 xp/hour can be gained by imbuing staves, and 245,600 xp/hour with wands and orbs (not counting time spent banking). The product can then be sold, or sacrificed at the Ourania Runecrafting altar for a significant chunk of experience. By stockpiling finished items and sacrificing them at level 109, up to 606,800 xp/hour can be gained with staves, and 519,600 xp/hour with wands and orbs (not counting time spent banking). Staves are recommended, because even though they require 20% more rune essence, they return 40% more xp per item. Wands and orbs have no difference in requirements or xp.

Using presets, rune essence pouches, and essence familiars will reduce the time spent banking. It is also recommended to have an unfinished imbued weapon and an inert item in the backpack, to start when the first one finishes.

This method is expensive but fast. Players should stock up on magical threads (and potentially Croesus flakes) beforehand due to the buy limit, should they wish to train with this method, as it only has a purchase limit of 1,000.

The Ourania Runecrafting Altar is a special Runecrafting altar located in the Ourania Cave, which is west of the Battlefield, and south of West Ardougne.

Players can get upwards of 66,000 XP/h[source needed] at level 82 runecrafting when crafting at the Ourania altar by using the Mobile and Wise perks and banking through teleportation while returning to the altar via Ourania Teleport.

Runespan has 2 Distractions and Diversions that can be participated in to gain additional Runecrafting experience.

Wizards can be found throughout Runespan. Players can gain Runecrafting experience as a reward from finding the wizard wearing yellow robes. It is possible to teleport directly to a yellow wizard using a yellow wizard teleport tablet, which may be purchased for 1,000 Runespan points, or an infinity ethereal body. Alternatively, speak to any of the wizards wearing blue robes or Wizard Finix to be told what direction the yellow wizard is currently located and to display an arrow which will indicate the yellow wizard's location. After locating the yellow wizard players can use a maximum of 10 runes on him to receive an experience reward. With at least level 77 Runecrafting players should give the wizard the type of rune that he request that the player gives to him. Players with level 76 or less Runecrafting should give the yellow wizard the highest level rune that they are able to craft. Players can be awarded up to 7,524 experience, with level 99 Runecrafting. This Distraction and Diversion can be completed every 10 minutes and first occurs 10 minutes after the player enters Runespan. A message in the player's chatbox will notify them when they become able to give the yellow wizard runes again, unless the player chooses not to help the wizard. The location of the yellow wizard is unique to each player and all of the wizards teleport to different locations every 4 minutes 31.5 seconds.

The runesphere is a Distraction and Diversion that occurs within the Runespan approximately every 2.5 hours, it involves a runesphere spawning on 1 of the dimension's 3 levels. A message in the player's chatbox will notify them of which level the runesphere has spawned on. An icon () is also displayed in Runespan interface when a runesphere is present; this tells the player on which floor the runesphere is present when hovered over. Runesphere teleport tablets may be used to teleport directly to an active runesphere: these can be bought for 2,000 Runespan points each. If the player does not have these teleports then they may speak to any wizard to get a hint about the direction in which the runesphere is located, though they must be on the same level as the runesphere. A runesphere is made up of layers of runic energy; each layer corresponds to a different type of rune that can be created within Runespan and has a particular level requirement to siphon. Players can siphon from the runesphere to receive Runecrafting experience and the runes of the type corresponding to the current layer of the runesphere. The runesphere's layers are destroyed over time, regardless of whether players are siphoning from the runesphere or not. Each layer of the runesphere takes between 2 and 3.5 minutes to break down. It takes around an hour to fully break down a runesphere. As the runesphere is broken down subsequent layers that require a lower Runecrafting level, but which award lower amounts of experience when siphoned from, are uncovered. The highest possible Runecrafting level that can be required to siphon from a runesphere is 92, in order to siphon from the initial soul. While siphoning from a runesphere players will also receive rune dust, up to a maximum of 1,000 rune dust per day. Rune dust can be exchanged for Runecrafting experience once per day by using it on the pure energy that appears after a runesphere has been completely broken down. This can give up to 25,000 experience, if exchanging 1,000 dust.

This guide describes the most effective methods to train the Runecrafting skill. The experience rate estimates in this guide do not incorporate the use of any experience boosting items or bonus experience. Runecrafting is an artisan skill that involves players using runecrafting altars to create runes from rune and pure essence. Levelling up the Runecrafting skill allows players to create runes which award greater amounts of experience when they are crafted. Having a higher Runecrafting level also increases the player's chance of creating multiple runes from a single piece of essence, though this does not grant additional Runecrafting experience.

Urns can be used to gain 20% additional Runecrafting experience while training. When held in the inventory, urns are filled as the player runecrafts. Only base experience counts towards filling the urn. Full urns can be teleported away to receive additional experience. Only one urn is filled at a time, though players may own up to a total of 10 full urns. If a player owns 10 full runecrafting urns they must teleport at least 1 away before they can fill more urns. Urns are only tradeable in their (nr), non-runed, forms. In order to use a runecrafting urn the player must add a pure essence to it; this makes the urn untradeable. Only members can mine pure essence, but free players may obtain it through the Grand Exchange, Runecrafting Guild Rewards of the Great Orb Project, monster drops, such as greater demon, giant mole, Hermod, the Spirit of War, or Sandy Caskets.

Parts of ethereal outfits can be crafted as a members by combining rune ethereal fragments with level 80 Runecrafting and 20 Invention. The death ethereal outfit, law ethereal outfit, blood ethereal outfits, and infinity ethereal outfit are free-to-play equipments, which consist of head slot, body slot, leg slot, hand slot and feet slot items.

When wearing a complete version of any of the death ethereal outfit, law ethereal outfit, and blood ethereal outfit, players gain the following bonuses:

  • Runes are not required or used up when using platforms to move between islands in Runespan (Runecrafting level requirements must still be met).
  • Chance of receiving double runes while creating runes in Runespan is increased by 5%.

Players who crafted all pieces of the death ethereal outfit, law ethereal outfit, and blood ethereal outfit could combine these outfits' components to form the infinity ethereal outfit. This outfit gives superior benefits to those given by the other ethereal outfits. Players gain the following bonuses from an infinity ethereal outfit:

  • Runes are not required or used up when using platforms to move between islands in Runespan (Runecrafting level requirements must still be met).
  • Chance of receiving double runes while creating runes in Runespan is increased by 7% (as opposed to 5% with the other ethereal outfits).
  • The infinity ethereal head can be used to teleport directly to the yellow wizard while in Runespan 5 times per day.
